title: Wire operator-bff StrategySpecSeedStore to canonical distillation seed store path and volume

root_cause.observed_symptom: GET /bff/management/strategy-seeds/seed-1d23a6d2fbc149f4 returned HTTP 404 on hosted dev despite canonical draft seed existing in /data/source-ingest/distill_seeds.jsonl.

owner_store_mismatch.strategy_seed_store_default: StrategySpecSeedStore.__init__ defaults to os.environ.get('STRATEGY_SEED_STORE_PATH', 'data/strategy_seed_store/seeds.jsonl') when instantiated without an explicit path (as in StrategiesService.seed_store, StrategySeedReplicationBridge, and _load_strategy_seed_match_candidates).
owner_store_mismatch.distillation_and_replication_workers: strategy-distillation-worker and alpha-replication-worker mounted source-ingest-data:/data/source-ingest and set STRATEGY_SPEC_SEED_STORE_PATH=/data/source-ingest/distill_seeds.jsonl.
owner_store_mismatch.operator_bff_before_fix: operator-bff set neither STRATEGY_SEED_STORE_PATH nor STRATEGY_SPEC_SEED_STORE_PATH and did not mount source-ingest-data:/data/source-ingest, so StrategySpecSeedStore read the unmounted relative path data/strategy_seed_store/seeds.jsonl.

preserved_invariants: SOURCE_INGEST_CONTROLLER_TOKEN_FILE remains absent from operator-bff environment
No data copy, migration, or reseeding
Original draft seed identity, status, and evidence/source lineage remain untouched

artifact_scope_boundary_evidence.conflicting_assertion: assert not any("source-ingest-data" in str(v) for v in services["operator-bff"].get("volumes", []))
artifact_scope_boundary_evidence.reason_for_expansion_request: AC1 requires wiring operator-bff StrategySpecSeedStore to the durable source-ingest-data seed file (/data/source-ingest/distill_seeds.jsonl) without data copy/migration/reseeding or a second store. Mounting source-ingest-data:/data/source-ingest in services.operator-bff.volumes triggers AssertionError at services/source_ingestion/test_compose_activation.py:155, which runs unconditionally in required Branch CI Gate (Smoke acceptance), while task_contract.py validate_task_artifact_diff_scope forbids modifying services/source_ingestion/test_compose_activation.py unless added to the task artifact contract.
